z-m-39-01.title: Shin ƙimomi daban-daban na iya samun jimla iri ɗaya?
z-m-39-01.topic: Ma'anar aiki da ayyuka masu ɗaya-da-ɗaya: sharadin jimillar ƙimomi da girman codomain.
z-m-39-01.goal: Yi amfani da misalin karyatawa don tabbatar da cewa ma'anar aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya (abubuwa daban-daban suna dacewa da ƙimomi daban-daban) ba ta faɗi komai game da jimillar ƙimomi ba, sannan bayyana cewa samuwar aiki mai wannan sharadi ya danganta da codomain.
z-m-39-01.material: Ka ɗauki aiki f daga yankin X={1, 2, 3, 4} zuwa codomain Y={1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7} a matsayin jadawalin ƙimomi. Jadawalin yana nuna f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4) kawai (babu wata dabara). Sharadi (가): f aiki ne na ɗaya-da-ɗaya, wato abubuwa daban-daban na X sun dace da ƙimomi daban-daban. Sharadi (나): f(1)+f(4)=f(2)+f(3). Mina ta ce, “Idan aiki ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne, ƙimomi huɗun duk sun bambanta. To jimillar kowane ma'aurata biyu ba za ta iya zama iri ɗaya ba kamar a (나).”
z-m-39-01.thinking.0: Matsar da da'awar zuwa jadawalin ƙimomi sannan ka gwada ta.
z-m-39-01.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalai daban-daban (misalan karyatawa) masu cika sharuddan.
z-m-39-01.thinking.2: Yanke hukunci gwargwadon sharadi kan ko irin wannan aiki zai iya samuwa idan codomain ya canza.
z-m-39-01.prereq.0: Ma'anar aiki, yankin, codomain, kewayon aiki, da ma'anar aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya (ɓangaren farko na rukunin ayyuka a lissafin gama-gari na sakandare).
z-m-39-01.prereq.1: Ƙirga abubuwan da ke cikin saiti.
z-m-39-01.prereq.2: (Zaton tsarin makaranta: H2 na wannan aiki lakabin wahala ne kawai da aka sanya a lokacin samarwa, kuma muna ɗauka an riga an koyi abubuwan da ake buƙata a sama.)
z-m-39-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukuncinka na farko game da maganar Mina. (Ba sai ka lissafta yanzu ba.)
z-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka ɗauki f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4) a matsayin gurabe huɗu, ka cika su da lambobi huɗu daban-daban.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.1: Da lambobin da ka cika, rubuta f(1)+f(4) da f(2)+f(3) dabam, sannan ka kwatanta ko sun yi daidai.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.a: Daidai. Idan ƙimomi huɗun duk sun bambanta, jimillar ma'aurata biyu ma za ta bambanta.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.a: Kana ɗaukar “ƙimomin sun bambanta” da “jimillar sun bambanta” a matsayin magana ɗaya. Ka zaɓi ma'aurata biyu na lambobi daban-daban da kanka, ka kwatanta jimlarsu.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.b: Daidai. Aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya yana ƙaruwa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa, saboda haka jimlolin ba za su iya zama daidai ba.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.b: Kana ɗaukar aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya da aikin mai ƙaruwa a matsayin abu ɗaya. Ka yi tunanin ko akwai ayyuka na ɗaya-da-ɗaya waɗanda ƙimominsu suke raguwa.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.c: Ba daidai ba. Ko da ƙimomi duka sun bambanta, jimillar ma'aurata daban-daban na iya zama iri ɗaya.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.c: Ka karanta da'awar a matsayin “koyaushe” kuma ka yi shakka ko akwai misali. Yanzu lokaci ya yi da za a gwada ko za a iya ƙirƙirar irin wannan misali da gaske.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.d: Ba za mu iya yanke hukunci ba. Domin ba a ba da dabarar f ba.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.d: Kana tunanin aiki a matsayin dabara kawai. A nan, jadawalin ƙimomi huɗun kaɗai ya isa a gwada sharuddan.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.explain: Sharadin aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya yana nufin ƙimomi huɗun kawai sun bambanta. Ko jimillar ma'aurata biyu za ta iya zama daidai alhali ƙimomi huɗun sun bambanta, sai an bincika ta hanyar nemo misali. Mu gwada hakan a mataki na gaba.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.prompt: Ta amfani da jadawalin ƙimomi, ƙirƙiri ayyuka f guda 2 masu cika sharuddan (가) da (나), kuma f(1) ya fi f(2) girma. Ayyukan biyu su yi amfani da jerin ƙimomi daban-daban. (a=f(1), b=f(2), c=f(3), d=f(4); duk lambobin cikakku ne daga 1 zuwa 7.)
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo rukuni na lambobi huɗu daban-daban inda f(1)+f(4) da f(2)+f(3) suka yi daidai.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka tsara lambobi huɗun da ka samu ta yadda f(1) ya fi f(2) girma, sannan ka sake tabbatar da cewa jimlolin biyu har yanzu daidai suke.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.2: Nemo wani rukuni guda ɗaya wanda lambobinsa suka bambanta da waɗanda aka yi amfani da su a aikin farko.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Ƙimomi huɗun duk abubuwa ne na codomain Y (lambobin cikakku daga 1 zuwa 7).
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne kowace ƙima ta zama lamba cikakkiya daga 1 zuwa 7.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Ƙimomi huɗun duk sun bambanta, don haka aiki ne na ɗaya-da-ɗaya.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c2: An yi amfani da ƙima ɗaya sau biyu. Ba aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba ne.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c3: f(1)+f(4) da f(2)+f(3) ba su yi daidai ba.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c4: f(1) bai fi f(2) girma ba.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.explain: Misali, (3, 1, 6, 4) yana da 3+4=7=1+6 kuma ƙimomi huɗun duk sun bambanta. Saboda haka da'awar Mina ba ta tabbata ba. Haka kuma, tun da akwai misali mai f(1)>f(2), aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba ya taswirar zuwa manyan ƙimomi kawai. ((1, 2, 3, 4) yana cika sharadin jimla amma ba ya cika f(1)>f(2), don haka ba a karɓe shi a wannan mataki ba.)
z-m-39-01.s.s3.prompt: Sabon bayani: yankin ya kasance X={1, 2, 3, 4}, sharuddan (가) da (나) sun kasance iri ɗaya, amma an canja codomain Y kamar yadda aka nuna a ƙasa. Zaɓi duk codomain ɗin da za a iya ƙirƙirar aiki f mai cika sharuddan. (Babu sharadin f(1)>f(2).)
z-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.0: A kowanne codomain, zaɓi lambobi huɗu daban-daban, raba su zuwa ma'aurata biyu, sannan ka rubuta jimillar ma'auratan biyu gefe da gefe.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.1: Idan codomain yana da abubuwa ƙasa da 4, fara ƙirga su don bincika ko za a iya ƙirƙirar aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya kwata-kwata.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.a: Da alama ka yi tunanin abubuwa 5 sun isa sosai. Zaɓi huɗu daga cikinsu, raba su zuwa ma'aurata biyu, sannan ka rubuta ko akwai yanayin da jimlolin suka yi daidai.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.b: Ba ka duba adadin abubuwa kaɗai ba, ka kuma kula da cewa lambobin suna da tazara iri ɗaya. Ka bincika ko ka sami ma'aurata biyu masu jimla ɗaya.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.c: Idan ka fara duba sharadin jimla, za ka iya kasa lura cewa abubuwan ba su isa ba. Da farko ƙirga yawan ƙimomin da ake buƙata domin aikin ya zama na ɗaya-da-ɗaya.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.d: Ka bincika ko codomain mai girma iri ɗaya da yankin yana da ma'aurata biyu masu jimla iri ɗaya. Ka yi la'akari da yanayin da aka yi amfani da lambobi huɗun duka.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.explain: {1,2,3} yana da abubuwa 3 kawai, don haka abubuwa huɗun X ba za su iya samun ƙimomi daban-daban ba, kuma babu aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya ko kaɗan. A {1,2,3,4}, 1+4=2+3; a {2,5,8,11,14} kuma akwai ma'aurata masu jimla ɗaya kamar 2+14=5+11. {1,2,4,8,16} yana da abubuwa 5, amma babu ma'aurata biyu daban-daban masu jimla iri ɗaya. Ba wai yawan abubuwa ne kawai yake isa ba; muhimmin abu shi ne waɗanne lambobi ne.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.prompt: Yi wa Mina bayani. Rubuta (1) inda da'awar farko ta yi kuskure, tare da misalin lambobi, da (2) cewa ba koyaushe ake samun aiki mai waɗannan sharudda ba, ta amfani da codomain.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.hint.0: Ɗauki ɗaya daga cikin jadawalin da ka yi a mataki na 2 kamar yadda yake, sannan ka rubuta ƙimomi huɗun da jimloli biyu.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.hint.1: Zaɓi codomain ɗaya da ba ka zaɓa a mataki na 3 ba, sannan ka rubuta a jumla guda dalilin da ya sa ba za a iya ƙirƙirar aiki da wannan codomain ba.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.placeholder: Misali: Aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya yana nufin ..., amma ...
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: A misalin lambobinka, ya bayyana cewa ƙimomi huɗun duk sun bambanta kuma jimillar ma'auratan biyu daidai take?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ka rarrabe abin da “ɗaya-da-ɗaya” ke gaya mana da abin da ba ya gaya mana?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ka ba da misalai (yanayin abubuwa ba su isa ba, ko yanayin babu ma'aurata masu jimla ɗaya) da ke nuna cewa aiki na iya samuwa ko rashin samuwa dangane da codomain?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.model.0: Ƙimomi huɗu daban-daban har yanzu na iya samun jimla iri ɗaya. Misali, idan f(1)=3, f(2)=1, f(3)=6, f(4)=4, to ƙimomin duk sun bambanta kuma 3+4=1+6=7. Amma idan codomain saitin ne kamar {1, 2, 4, 8, 16}, wanda ba shi da ma'aurata biyu masu jimla ɗaya, ba za a iya ƙirƙirar irin wannan aiki ba.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.model.1: Aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya yana nufin ƙimomi ba sa maimaituwa kawai; ba ya nufin jimlolin sun bambanta. Idan f(1)=2, f(2)=1, f(3)=4, f(4)=3, to 2+3=1+4=5, saboda haka jimlolin daidai suke. Amma idan codomain yana da abubuwa 3 kawai, babu ma aikin ɗaya-da-ɗaya, don haka samuwar aiki ta danganta da saitin codomain.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Ba a ambaci ko ƙimomin suna ƙaruwa ba, amma an bayar da misalin karyatawa da sharadin codomain duka.
